info.title: SealTrail API
info.description: Tamper-evident Digital Evidence Chain-of-Custody & Case Workspace

get.description: Liveness probe returning 200 when Uvicorn is active.
Readiness probe checking PostgreSQL connection, S3 storage, and chain head.

post.description:
Authenticate user credentials, enforce lockout after threshold failures,
set httpOnly refresh cookie and return access token.
Silent refresh of access token using httpOnly cookie.
Log out current user and clear refresh cookie.

get.description: Return currently authenticated user profile.
List all user accounts in the system.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Users Get

post.description: Create a new user account with validated password complexity.

patch.description: Update user attributes (role, active status, name, or password).

get.description:
List accessible cases based on caller role:
- ADMIN cannot view cases (separation of duties -> 403).
- SUPERVISOR and AUDITOR view all cases.
- INVESTIGATOR and CUSTODIAN view cases where they hold membership.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api V1 Cases Get

post.description: Create a new case, assign case number, and register creator as Lead.

get.description: Get case details subject to case isolation authorization.

post.description: Close an open case (Case Lead or Supervisor only).

get.description: List members assigned to the case.

schema.title: Response Get Members Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Members Get

post.description: Add a user to the case (Lead or Supervisor only).

delete.description: Remove a member from the case (Lead or Supervisor only).

get.description:
Get merged chronological timeline for the case.
Merges manually logged case events and immutable audit chain entries.

schema.title: Response Get Timeline Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Timeline Get

get.description: Search and filter evidence items with server-side pagination.
Export evidence metadata CSV (audited, working copy).

post.description: Intake digital evidence with streaming SHA-256 and read-back verification.

get.description: Get evidence details and audit EVIDENCE_VIEWED.
Validate check character and resolve evidence item by number.

post.description: Trigger three-way cryptographic verification on an evidence item.

get.description:
Download evidence file.
Verifies cryptographic hash first. Blocks on failure unless SUPERVISOR force=true.
AUDITOR is forbidden from downloading working copies.

post.description: Generate controlled PDF label with QR code, track reprint counter, and audit.

get.description: Retrieve full chronological custody and audit events for this specific item.

post.description: Initiate an internal or external custody transfer.

get.description: List transfers with status and role filters.

schema.title: Response List Transfers Api V1 Transfers Get

post.description: Acknowledge receipt of transferred evidence with hash re-verification.
Reject pending custody transfer.
Cancel pending custody transfer by sender.

get.description: List approval requests (filter by status or requests authored by caller).

schema.title: Response List Approvals Api V1 Approvals Get

post.description: Approve dual-authorization request (Supervisor other than requester).
Reject dual-authorization request.
Cancel pending request by the original requester.

get.description: List append-only annotations for an evidence item.

schema.title: Response Get Annotations Api V1 Evidence  Evidence Id  Annotations Get

post.description: Create an append-only annotation on evidence.

get.description: List persons linked to a case.

schema.title: Response Get People Api V1 Cases  Case Id  People Get

post.description: Add a person of interest to a case.

get.description: List timeline incident events for a case.

schema.title: Response Get Case Events Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Events Get

post.description: Record an incident timeline event.

get.description: List append-only investigation notes.

schema.title: Response Get Case Notes Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Notes Get

post.description: Add an append-only case investigation note.

get.description: List links connecting evidence to people, events, notes, or other evidence.

schema.title: Response Get Evidence Links Api V1 Evidence  Evidence Id  Links Get

post.description: Link evidence to a person, event, note, or other evidence without touching evidence_items.
Revoke a link without deleting it (soft revocation, audited).

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api V1 Alerts Get
Response List Checkpoints Api V1 Audit Checkpoints Get
Response Get Retention Policies Api V1 Retention Policies Get
